title: Object Storage: outage credit — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage outage credit, post the negative of the smaller of additional entitlement and the approved claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; net amount equals amount and tax amount is zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage credit in this situation? Post the negative of the smaller of additional entitlement and the approved claimed amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; net amount equals amount and tax amount is zero.

## Hypothetical outage credit amount

Assume hypothetical additional entitlement of USD 45 and an approved claimed amount of USD 38. The financial concession is negative USD 38; its net amount is the same and its tax amount is zero.
